author: The Critical Drinker
description:
Godzilla Minus Zero is here, let's find out if its any good. Also, Taika Waititi crashed out big time when his new movie Klara And The Sun bombed at the box office. And do we finally have a new James Bond  actor cast? Join me, MauLer, FilmComicsExplained, Random Film Talk, Angry Badger and Price of Reason as we find out.
